output.why: The proposed change directly conflicts with the technical specification, P&ID, and Datasheet A, which all explicitly specify two (2) Sludge Sump Transfer Pumps in a 1 working + 1 standby (2x100%) configuration. Adding a third pump also impacts the physical layout of the E14 Sludge Sump (where one pump is installed in each of the two 6.25 m3 compartments) and the electrical MCC feeder requirements.
